description: This PHP source file defines the VacancyDetailedModel class within the OrangeHRM Recruitment API module. It models the detailed data structure for a job vacancy, including properties such as ID, name, description, number of positions, status, publication state, and associated entities like job title and hiring manager. The model uses traits for serialization and specifies filters and attribute mappings for API responses.

classes.name: VacancyDetailedModel
classes.description: A model class representing detailed information about a job vacancy, implementing serialization and normalization functionalities for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a Vacancy entity and sets up filters and attribute mappings.
